title: Easy Chicken Cutlets with Apples
description: This easy chicken cutlets with apples recipe features chicken cutlets coated with seasoned flour, browned in butter, and served with sweetened apples.
ingredients: 1 Granny Smith apple - cored, peeled, and cut into 1/2-inch thick wedges

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C).
Sprinkle chicken with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Place on a rack, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Halve lengthwise to make 4 equal-sized pieces.
Place each piece of chicken between plastic and pound with smooth side of a meat mallet to make 1/4-inch thick cutlets.
Mix flour, cornstarch, remaining 1 teaspoon salt, pepper, and sugar together in a shallow bowl. Dredge cutlets in flour mixture to coat; shake off excess.

Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat until foam disappears; add chicken and cook until golden brown, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to a heat-proof plate; keep warm in the preheated oven.

Bring sherry to a boil in the skillet, scraping brown bits from bottom of pan; cook until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. Stir in broth and apples; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until broth is reduced by half. Stir in brown sugar, remaining 1 tablespoon butter, and Marsala wine; cook until sugar dissolves and sauce thickens.
Return chicken to the skillet with any juice from the plate; turn to coat in sauce. Simmer, about 2 minutes per side. Serve topped with apples and sauce.
